description:
Ground elevation and slope for every residential mesh block: median, lowest and highest ground level, typical and steepest slope, and the share of homes on flat or steep land.

Coverage: All states and territories; blocks with at least three addressed properties. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/terrain-block`.

One call returns every mesh block in the suburb.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

name: suburbs_mesh_blocks_terrain
title: Terrain by mesh block (by suburb)
